templates.details:
Both subclavian, brachial and axillary artery appear normal in course and caliber on both sides. No e/o thrombosis / Atherosclerosis / Stenosis / Aneurysm. On CDI and spectral waveform, they show normal flow and velocity.
Both subclavian & axillary veins show normal flow pattern.

Both ulnar and radial vessels appear normal in course and caliber on both sides. No e/o thrombosis / Atherosclerosis / Stenosis / Aneurysm. On CDI and spectral waveform, they show normal flow and velocity.
Veins show normal compressibility.

Superficial veins of both upper limbs show normal course and flow pattern.

COMMENTS: Normal Bilateral Upper Limb Doppler.

LIVER: Normal in size and shape. Normal parenchymal echotexture. No focal lesion seen. Intrahepatic biliary radicals are not dilated.
GALL BLADDER: Well distended. Wall thickness is normal. No calculus or mass lesion seen.
COMMON BILE DUCT & PORTAL VEIN: Normal in caliber.
PANCREAS: Visualized head, body, and tail appear normal in size and echotexture. No focal lesion or calcification.
SPLEEN: Normal in size with homogeneous echotexture. No focal lesion seen.
KIDNEYS: Both kidneys are normal in size, shape, position, and cortical echotexture. Cortico-medullary differentiation is well maintained. No calculus or hydronephrosis seen.
URINARY BLADDER: Well distended, wall thickness is normal. No calculus or mass lesion seen.
PROSTATE / UTERUS & ADNEXA: Normal for age.

IMPRESSION: No significant sonological abnormality detected in whole abdomen and pelvis.

Both lung fields appear clear with normal vascular markings.
No focal parenchymal consolidation, cavitation, or mass lesion seen.
Hilar shadows are within normal limits.
Cardiac size and configuration are within normal limits (Cardiothoracic ratio normal).
Both costophrenic and cardiophrenic angles are clear.
Bony thorax and surrounding soft tissue structures appear intact.

IMPRESSION: Normal Chest Radiograph (PA View).

AORTIC ROOT & VALVE: Trileaflet aortic valve with normal opening and closure. No AS / AR.
MITRAL VALVE: Normal leaflets and subvalvular apparatus. No MS / MR.
TRICUSPID VALVE: Structurally normal. Trivial TR. Estimated PASP within normal limits.
PULMONIC VALVE: Normal.
CHAMBERS: Normal LV, RV, LA, and RA cavity dimensions. No thrombus or vegetations.
LV FUNCTION: Normal LV systolic function. LVEF = 60-65%. No regional wall motion abnormality (RWMA) at rest.
PERICARDIUM: Normal, no pericardial effusion.

CONCLUSION: Normal resting 2D Transthoracic Echocardiogram. Good LV systolic function.

HAEMOGLOBIN: 14.2 g/dL (Reference: Male 13.0 - 17.0, Female 12.0 - 15.0)
TOTAL RBC COUNT: 4.8 mill/cu.mm (Reference: 4.5 - 5.5)
TOTAL LEUCOCYTE COUNT (WBC): 7,400 /cu.mm (Reference: 4,000 - 11,000)

DIFFERENTIAL LEUCOCYTE COUNT:
- Polymorphs (Neutrophils): 64 % (Reference: 40 - 70)
- Lymphocytes: 28 % (Reference: 20 - 40)
- Eosinophils: 04 % (Reference: 01 - 06)
- Monocytes: 04 % (Reference: 02 - 08)
- Basophils: 00 % (Reference: 00 - 01)

PLATELET COUNT: 2.40 Lakhs/cu.mm (Reference: 1.50 - 4.50 Lakhs)
PERIPHERAL SMEAR: Normocytic normochromic RBCs. Normal WBC distribution and adequate platelets.
